events.title: PLAY Expo Blackpool
events.summary: You're Alive, Phil, is heading to Blackpool for PLAY Expo this weekend, October 3rd and 4th, at Norbreck Castle Exhibition Centre. If you're in the area, and especially if you like retro games, come check it out and give Phil a play!

events.title: You're Alive, Phil Release Date
events.summary: The official release date is locked in!You're Alive, Phil, will be released at 6:00 PM GMT / 10:00 AM PST on the 11th of November, 2026!At this stage, the game is all but complete, save for a handful of levels I have to create. events.title: Phil Is Coming to Next Fest!
events.summary: You're Alive, Phil is registered for Steam's October Next Fest, with release to follow shortly after the conclusion of the event!Work on the game has been chugging along. Some dev contract work and a big submission in my ongoing Games Programming degree slowed things down a little (but nothing that wasn't planned for).The game is now fully written, and there are around 15 more levels to make (I'd also like to tighten a few of the existing ones up a bit).
